record.body: Durable learning: when a producer-owned reusable adapter already exists and independent consumer branches have exact-head courts ALIVE, capital allocation should remove metadata/containment suppressors before creating parallel consumer machinery. Aggregate repository CI may remain red without invalidating a scoped verification-only consumer when the changed-file boundary contains no runtime source and the failures are independently localized outside the diff; preserve the aggregate BUILD_BROKEN evidence rather than laundering it. After containment, the production-function frontier advances to multi-receipt assimilation, independence/common-cause measurement, and causal dependency-relief yield.
